note: Snapshot for maintainers; the studio never fetches these at runtime. Curated fields: category, notes, indexed (entries); notes, inToolbox (resources). Refresh with node tools/refresh-sources.mjs.

categories.product: Product, SaaS, AI and developer tools
categories.commerce: Commerce, type foundries and physical products

items.title: KISAWAPFE
items.notes: Name set edge to edge as the masthead and every other line at caption size: two type sizes and one lo-fi image carry the fold.

items.title: .softGlossary
items.notes: Code-made imagery (ASCII) for a site about web design and code; one italic serif word carries the brand's own term.

items.title: Moonbeam
items.notes: A cinematic render, a staggered three-line headline and a live network-stats strip as proof.

items.title: Vivien's Creative
items.notes: A full-bleed black-and-white photograph carries the emotion; a giant wordmark cropped at the bottom edge and one serif sentence frame it.

items.title: Bleibtgleich
items.notes: One red does every job (type, rules, mark) on off-white; visible crosshair construction lines and a dry one-line voice.

items.title: Dub
items.notes: The conventional SaaS hero done precisely: medium-weight headline, real product UI with plausible data, a product tab switcher.

items.title: Neon
items.notes: Feature visuals are diagrams of the concept (light paths for scaling, splitting lines for branching); the accent is rationed to logo and CTA.

items.title: Tars AI
items.notes: The brand object (a chrome logo form) is the hero inside a stepped gradient grid, flanked by two short claims.

items.title: Cosmos
items.notes: The product's content orbits the wordmark in 3D; the corners hold utilities (theme toggle, scroll cue).

items.title: Humble
items.notes: Shows the actual user (a factory operator) instead of abstract AI imagery; editorial three-column hero; accent down to a full stop.

items.title: Hugo Baron
items.notes: One saturated field plus black; a cropped condensed-name marquee, numbered nav and a live local clock turn metadata into texture.

items.title: Conway World
items.notes: Monochrome illustration in the brand colour only; a sans masthead with a serif deck for editorial voice.

items.title: Miller McCormick
items.notes: No hero: the homepage is the body of work as an irregular thumbnail field, with the bio cut to a four-line caption.

items.title: Quo
items.notes: Social proof above the headline, product UI filled with believable conversations, one saturated CTA colour used twice.

items.title: T for Troels
items.notes: Strict label and value columns under tiny grey headers, a full-width name between hairlines, one hand-drawn scribble breaking the grid.

items.title: ATIO Studio
items.notes: Wordmark bleeding off the top edge, then projects as five-column metadata rows; a deadpan spec line names the background colour.

items.title: Darkroom
items.notes: A layers panel drawn over the product photograph explains, inside the hero, that the mockup is editable.

items.title: Driftime
items.notes: Client work shown in use by a person on a real laptop instead of a flat mockup, under a heavy caps headline.

items.title: L'Étude
items.notes: Three-colour poster logic: a photo panel knocks out the heavy wordmark it overlaps; a dictionary definition is the voice.

items.title: Mekuwelt
items.notes: Split screen: one loud saturated image half against a silent half holding an almost invisible embossed monogram.

items.title: ARTWORLD

items.title: Lelism

items.title: SavoirFaire
items.notes: A condensed didone wordmark sits on the bottom edge like a horizon, empty black above, an instruction marquee on top.

items.title: Caso Patrimoine

items.title: Habillage Graphique

items.title: SUB

items.title: The Swaddle

items.title: Daniel Herzog

items.title: Gio Pandone

items.title: Tatsiana Shevarenkova

items.title: Ben Mingo

items.title: Kaer

items.title: Studio Museum in Harlem

items.title: SSENSE XX

items.title: Luisa Ruzzenenti

items.title: New Genre

items.title: Omosa

items.title: VAP

items.title: Claude Type

items.title: Unknown, Untitled

items.title: Adcker

items.title: Exe

resources.description: A library of interactive UI blocks you can explore, tweak, and take straight into your projects.

resources.title: Family Values
resources.description: What makes Family, Family.
resources.notes: Benji Taylor on Family: simplicity through trays revealed in context, fluidity by never teleporting or duplicating, and delight placed inversely to frequency, with polish held even across rare screens.

resources.title: Design Engineering: A State of Mind
resources.description: Finding my dream role blending code, design, and product thinking
resources.notes: Andy Zhang: design engineering as a state of mind; rotate between engineer, designer and PM views to find the global rather than local maximum.

resources.title: Front-of-the-front-end and back-of-the-front-end web development
resources.notes: Brad Frost splits front-end work: the look and feel of a button versus what happens when it is clicked; a component library is the handshake.

resources.title: Calligraph
resources.description: Fluid text transitions powered by Motion

resources.title: HTML Can Do That
resources.description: HTML has been gobbling up swathes of what used to be JavaScript’s remit. This page lists a bunch of dynamic functionality that we can now achieve with just HTML.
resources.notes: Chris Burnell's list of what HTML now does without JavaScript: popover, dialog, exclusive details, invoker commands, lazy loading, hidden until-found, native inputs (with accessibility caveats).

resources.title: The Component Gallery
resources.description: An up-to-date repository of interface components based on examples from the world of design systems, designed to be a reference for anyone building user interfaces.

resources.title: Corner Radii
resources.description: A tool to calculate perfect nested border radii.

resources.title: crd-ui
